title: GO:0000018 · Similarity-aware: ROC and PR curves
caption: Test-set ROC (top) and precision–recall (bottom) curves for seven classifiers on conjoint-triad (left) and k-separated bigram PSSM (right) features, GO:0000018 similarity-aware split, n = 85 with 33% positive. The thin horizontal line in the PR panels is the positive prevalence. Highest AUROC among the 14 curves: k-sep. bigram PSSM with MLP (0.929).
